raw_response:
The figure is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the percentage of respondents who believe certain measures could limit the “hidden economy” of a country. The horizontal axis lists various proposed measures, including “Да се засили граничния контрол” (Strengthen border control), “Да се ограничи действията на мафията” (Limit mafia activities), and others, arranged in a seemingly arbitrary order. The vertical axis represents the percentage of respondents, ranging from 0% to 13%, with a linear scale and increments of 1%. Each bar corresponds to a specific measure, and its length indicates the percentage of respondents who support that measure. The bars are all the same color, a shade of red. The highest percentage, 13%, is associated with “Да се подобри качеството на административните…” (Improve the quality of administrative…), while the lowest percentages, 2% each, are associated with “Да се засили граничния контрол” (Strengthen border control) and “Да се намалят акцизите” (Reduce excise duties). The percentages are directly labeled on the bars.
